why: DMN 1.6 Table 67, years: "The normalized years component of a years and months duration value as an integer"; months: "Since the value is normalized, this property must return an integer in the interval [0.. 11]". Owner decision: every duration component is a magnitude, so -P1Y2M has the years 1 and the months 2, as the days, hours, minutes and seconds of a days and time duration already are; the sign belongs to the duration.
